Mint or deposit $100 of the stable asset through RIF ON CHAIN on RSK. Cost: $100 of capital and about $4 of gas. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Mint a second $25 of the asset after two weeks, once the first mint shows yield accruing. Cost: $25 of capital and about $3 of gas. Time: 10 minutes.
Make one qualifying action each week, such as a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a vote, and never let two weeks pass with no activity. Cost: about $2 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 30 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot. Cost: the $100 stays in the position. Time: 30 days.
Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own points or rewards page and claim only from the link it publishes. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.
Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm log, then unwind in reverse order and keep $5 of gas on RSK for the exit. Cost: about $3 of gas to unwind. Time: 10 minutes to close.

Stake a second tranche of $25 after the first epoch, so the position grows in two steps. Cost: $25 of capital and about $3 of gas. Time: 10 minutes.
Make one qualifying action each week, such as a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a vote, and never let two weeks pass with no activity. Cost: about $2 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 30 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot. Cost: the $50 stays in the position. Time: 30 days.
Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own points or rewards page and claim only from the link it publishes. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.
Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm log, then unwind in reverse order and keep $5 of gas on ZIGChain for the exit. Cost: about $3 of gas to unwind. Time: 10 minutes to close.
